description: The monthly payment, total interest and total paid on a car loan from the amount financed, APR and term, with what a term over 60 months adds in interest compared with 60. Use it for a loan on its own; out_the_door works the payment from a car price, and refinance_check compares a new loan with an existing one.

amount.description: Amount financed: the out-the-door price less the down payment and trade equity
